bug_fixed_2026-09-07.description: Found via carrier/lift/harness/GCC_X87.md SS4: line_intersect's ua/ub NaN guards (D==0 && numerator==0, i.e. segments sharing their start point) were written as `if (!(ua >= 0.0)) return 0;` / `if (!(ub >= 0.0)) return 0;`, which reject on NaN because `NaN >= 0.0` is false and the negation is true. The original x87 code's fucom/fnstsw/test $0x45,%ah/je idiom only branches on the ORDERED true case, so a NaN ua/ub falls through every guard uncaught; the original then runs a masked fistp on NaN+0.5 (integer indefinite 0x80000000), writes garbage coordinates, and returns EAX=1, whereas the un-fixed source returned EAX=0 on those vectors -- a toolchain-independent mismatch (948-1011 of every 20000 vectors, identical across every MSVC and GCC build tried, unrelated to floating-point precision). Fix: rewrote the two guards as `if (ua < 0.0) return 0;` / `if (ub < 0.0) return 0;` (matching the already-correct `ua > 1.0` / `ub > 1.0` guards) so C's IEEE-754 comparison semantics reproduce the same NaN-falls-through behaviour as the hardware's unordered fucom, with no change to arithmetic order or to the pre-existing x87 double-vs-80-bit precision gap.

line_intersect.note: Post-fix (2026-09-07): the toolchain-independent EAX bug on fully-degenerate D==0 (NaN ua/ub) inputs is fixed in src/icytower/line_intersect.c (see bug_fixed_2026-09-07 above and src/icytower/PROMOTIONS.md). What remains, under the plain MSVC cl.exe build this harness's default src_check.exe uses (no /arch override, no long-double/softfloat), is exactly the pre-existing, previously-documented x87 double-vs-80-bit extended-precision gap (carrier/lift/README.md SS6b, artifacts/lift_x87_finding.md): this function keeps every FP intermediate in the x87 register stack and needs genuine 80-bit precision, which MSVC's default double model does not give it (49/33/46/48 of 20000 per seed, all comparison-domain, 0 EAX diffs -- carrier/lift/harness/GCC_X87.md). GCC 32-bit MinGW with -mfpmath=387 -mno-sse2 -O1/-O2 (harness/GCC_X87.md) IS bit-exact: EQUAL over 80000 vectors (4 seeds x 20000). This remains a build-configuration gap for the MSVC comparator, not a source-recovery gap -- promoted with this caveat; do not carrier-bind at 0x406b80 until the carrier build adopts a real 80-bit x87 config.

memory_model_note: src/icytower/*.c is address-free ordinary C with no PF_MEM seam of its own (by design, see src/README.md). pf_bindings_harness.h's per-global PF_MEM() macros are sufficient for every direct global access (reward_time, reward_scale, player_id, ply, logic_count), but NOT for a pointer VALUE the code reads out of guest memory and then dereferences (update_frame's ply[player_id], and is_solid's own `m` parameter, which the real carrier passes as a plain guest VA because there a guest VA IS a valid host pointer). carrier/lift/harness/src_check.c closes that specific, narrow gap at its two call sites (documented in its header comment) rather than in src/ itself; an identity-mapped guest image (VirtualAlloc at the real 0x400000 base, matching how the real carrier maps the image) was tried first and ruled out empirically -- VirtualQuery showed 0x400000..0x800000 already densely occupied by loader/heap-manager mappings in this process before main() runs.
